read: the close fell 8.90% from saturday 31 october to saturday 7 november, after falling 9.65% the week before. it sits 15.54% below the 50 week average, after 7.72% below it a week earlier, the widest gap under that line in nine weeks, since the week to 5 september 2026. hashrate read 355.09 PH/s on saturday 7 november and averaged 356.11 PH/s from 1 to 7 november, against 356.32 PH/s from 25 to 31 october, in our own daily log.
